@kt.kernel
def k(
    a=kt.In(64, 64, dtype="mx7a", layout={"gm": 16, "nk": 1}),
    b=kt.In(32, 64, dtype="mx7b", layout={"gn": 8, "nk": 1}),
    x=kt.In(64, 32),
    q=kt.Out(64, 32, dtype="mx7a", layout={"gm": 16, "nk": 1}),
    y=kt.Out(64, 32),
):
    h = kt.buffer((64, 32), "f16", tile=(16, 8))
    g = kt.buffer((64, 32), "f16", tile=(16, 8))
    kt.copy(y, x)
    kt.quant(q, x)
    kt.gt4(g, x)
    kt.fill_value(y, 0)
    for u in kt.par(1, on=kt.mg):
        acc = kt.zero(64, 32)
        acc = kt.gemm(kt.fill(a[0:64, 0:32]), kt.fill(b[0:32, 0:32]), acc)
        kt.drain(acc, h)
    for c in kt.par(2, on=kt.vc):
        for t in kt.range(8):
            r = c * 32 + t * 4
            v = kt.load(h[r : r + 4, :])
            kt.store(y[r : r + 4, :], kt.recip(v) * kt.rmax(v))
